objectives.title: Buy coal at the border
objectives.hint: Use Buy coal to import coal at the border post.

objectives.title: Dispatch coal to storage
objectives.hint: Dispatch a depot truck from the border post to storage.

objectives.title: Deliver coal to the heating plant
objectives.hint: Dispatch a second truck from storage to the heating plant.

objectives.title: Reach 100 heat units
objectives.hint: Keep the heating plant supplied until it stores 100 heat units.
